creeks.note: Flood Monitoring = potential for 50% channel capacity exceedance downstream; Flood Watch = 75%; Flood Warning = 100% (flooding likely).

creeks.name: Belmont Creek
creeks.intro: Creek level at Old County Road, rain at Old County Road, and the Bay tide at Redwood City. Thresholds are for the Harbor Industrial Area community downstream of the Caltrain crossing. Flooding is likely if 30-minute rain exceeds 0.20 inches, or if 4-hour rain exceeds 0.42 inches and the tide is high.
creeks.note: Flood Monitoring = potential for 50% channel capacity exceedance downstream; Flood Watch = 75%; Flood Warning = 100% (flooding likely).

creeks_preview.intro: Creek level at Stanford (USGS), rain in the hills above at Wunderlich, Windy Hill and Trappers Trail, and the Bay tide at Redwood City.
creeks_preview.note: Flood levels at Stanford are OneRain's (Oct 2026): Flood Monitoring = potential flooding; Flood Watch = flooding likely; Flood Warning = projected flooding in downstream reaches. Not yet reviewed by staff. Tide station to confirm.

creeks_preview.name: San Mateo Creek
creeks_preview.intro: Creek level below Crystal Springs Reservoir (USGS), rain at Crystal Springs Cottage nearby, and the Bay tide at Alameda. Crystal Springs Reservoir holds back much of the water from the upper watershed.
creeks_preview.note: Flood levels below Crystal Springs are OneRain's (Oct 2026), which OneRain sets on flow: Flood Watch = 200 cfs (about 6.70 ft), flooding probable with continued rain; Flood Warning = 250 cfs (about 7.00 ft), active flooding likely downstream. Not yet reviewed by staff. Tide station to confirm.

creeks_preview.name: Green Hills Creek

creeks_preview.note: No flood levels have been set for this creek yet. Its status uses rain in the hills above and how fast the creek is rising. Tide station to confirm.
